scripts.build: algokit compile ts smart_contracts --output-source-map --out-dir artifacts && algokit generate client smart_contracts/artifacts --output {app_spec_dir}/{contract_name}Client.ts
scripts.deploy:futurenet: npm run build && DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.futurenet ts-node --transpile-only -r dotenv/config smart_contracts/index.ts
scripts.deploy:testnet: npm run build && DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.testnet ts-node --transpile-only -r dotenv/config smart_contracts/index.ts
scripts.deploy:mainnet: npm run build && DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.mainnet ts-node --transpile-only -r dotenv/config smart_contracts/index.ts
scripts.test:hybrid-falcon-lsig: npm run build && ts-node --transpile-only -r dotenv/config smart_contracts/run-hybrid-falcon-lsig.ts
